dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent closed-loop annuli on the mid-dorsal flank exhibit sharp high-contrast transitions from dark perimeters to lighter grey interiors. The edge geometries are irregular and crenulated, with the most distinct 'O' shape showing a high-gradient boundary between the dark exterior fur and the lighter interior ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of interconnected high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated on the anterior dorsal region. These blobs lack internal gradients and form a dense, asymmetrical network of solid light-toned pixels stretching from the neck towards the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three primary mid-dorsal annuli form a compact scalene triangle. An additional geometric relationship is visible as a linear chain of four smaller high-intensity blobs extending posteriorly along the upper dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, continuous, high-intensity reticulated pattern with a complex map-like topology is located on the lower lateral flank, distinct from the discrete circular annuli found elsewhere on the body.
